title: Relatives who were musicians; Uncle Walter's choir
summary: Mrs. Howard clarifies the family: his sister, cousin Gladys Scippio and Uncle Walter, who directed the Wesley Chapel choir; his mother Jennie Snowden.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
